Title: Transparent data encryption with bring your own key (BYOK) support for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Data Warehouse

Body.Content:
We’re glad to announce the preview of transparent data encryption with bring your own key (BYOK) support for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Data Warehouse. You can now have control of the keys used for encryption at rest with transparent data encryption by storing these master keys in Azure Key Vault.

With this added support, your organization can assume higher control over key management. Use a key from Key Vault for encryption at rest, and control who has access to your data and when. 

Learn more in this blog post.
